editorial:
Imagine being stuck in a scary place with your crush, only to find out that a monster is pretending to be that exact person to trick you. You get to follow two teenage boys who are deeply in love but are suddenly hunted by a mean spirit. The vibe is a wild mix of sweet romance and total nightmare fuel. It starts off feeling like a typical coming-of-age story, but it quickly turns into a game of cat and mouse where you never know if the person you are holding is actually your boyfriend or a creature trying to eat you alive.

The acting is great and makes you really care if these two survive. The pacing stays fast, and the twists will definitely make you jump. One downside is that some of the monster effects look a bit fake, but the tension makes up for it. You should definitely watch this if you like scary movies with a lot of heart. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the detail, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: At the very end, the boys realize the monster cannot tell them apart because their love is the same. They trick the entity by pretending to hate each other, which confuses the creature and makes it lose its form. One boy sacrifices himself to trap the monster in a mirror, but he survives at the last second. They both escape the house together, finally safe and knowing their bond is stronger than any monster.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves scary movies with a romantic twist.
